analysis: Limited patient-nested XGBoost tuning with a fixed Random Forest component
input: Frozen 2026-10-15 prepared original 104/43 nominal matrices, labels, denominators, patient groups and outer test assignments
selection: Highest unweighted mean of three inner held-out AUROCs; exact tie uses candidate order. No outer-test predictions or outcomes enter selection.
training_seed: 42 for SCH/WHU and outer fold number for MIMIC; unchanged across candidate configurations
preprocessing: Chinese original zero fill; MIMIC median plus empty-column removal fitted only to the relevant training role. No feature changes, including known limitations of original MIMIC mapping.
inner_training: For each candidate and each inner fold, split inner-training patients into stopping-fit and stopping-validation roles, select rounds there, then refit on all inner-training patients and score the untouched inner scoring fold. Both stages refit preprocessing and class weights only from their own fitting patients.
outer_training: Fit chosen candidate on all outer-training patients using floor(median of its three inner selected round counts), at least one round. Fit the fixed candidate under the same median-round rule as a matched nested baseline. No final use of outer-test labels.
rf_component: Reuse only the corresponding original saved outer-training RF, after exact preprocessor/feature/role/prediction replay. The unchanged RF is not tuned. Combine 50:50 with the new chosen or fixed XGBoost component.
bootstrap_scope: Paired target-patient cluster resampling of fixed OOF predictions; conditional percentile 95% intervals, no retraining or selection uncertainty and no multiplicity adjustment
limits: Not exhaustive model selection or RF tuning
Not a revival of deprecated v12 nested-CV results
Not a mapping, timing, endpoint or censoring repair
Not prospective or new external validation
No selection of the best outer-test model, seed, or cohort result
